description: Non-material amendment to development description to introduce 2 phase delivery, addition of phasing plan under condition 2 (approved drawings) and new phasing conditionof Variation of Conditions reference 23/3374 dated 23 October, 2024 (as amended by Non Material Amendment ref. 24/3617) for Variation of condition 2 (development built in accordance with approved plans and/or documents) to include: 	an uplift in homes from 45 to 62;	an additional storey from 6 to 7 storeys;	enlarged community space at ground floor;	addition of basement carpark;	other associated changes;and associated changes to condition 3 (number of units), condition 4 (quantum of commercial floorspace), condition 5 (wheelchair accessible homes), condition 13 (flank windows), condition 27 (air quality) and condition 30 (number of storeys) of planning permission reference 20/2096 dated 17/07/2022 for 'Construction of a single building to provide residential units, and flexible commercial/community use floorspace, car and cycle parking, associated landscaping, highways and infrastructure works, and provision of pedestrian and vehicular access, subject to Deed of Agreement dated 16th June 2022  and a Deed of Variation dated 17th of October 2024 under Section 106 of Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended.
